title: Remove inactive MacPorts packages
summary: Clean up old versions of packages that are no longer in use.

steps.explain: Uninstall packages that are installed but not currently active (e.g., old versions). Requires administrator privileges.

rollback.explain: Reinstall the specific package if you accidentally removed something needed.

placeholders.name: PACKAGE
placeholders.description: The name of the package to reinstall.

warnings: This removes old versions. Ensure you do not need them for compatibility reasons.
